description: This file defines the DSQLClient class for interacting with the Amazon Aurora DSQL service via the AWS SDK in PHP. It includes method annotations for operations like creating, deleting, listing, and managing clusters and resources.

classes.name: Aws\DSQL\DSQLClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Aurora DSQL service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Creates a new Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: createClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: createMultiRegionClusters
methods.description: Creates multiple Aurora DSQL clusters across regions.

methods.name: createMultiRegionClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates multiple clusters across regions.

methods.name: deleteCluster
methods.description: Deletes an existing Aurora DSQL cluster.

methods.name: deleteClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an existing cluster.

methods.name: deleteMultiRegionClusters
methods.description: Deletes multiple clusters across regions.

methods.name: deleteMultiRegionClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes multiple clusters across regions.

methods.name: getCluster
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific cluster.

methods.name: getClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves cluster details.

methods.name: listClusters
methods.description: Lists all clusters.

methods.name: listClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all clusters.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateCluster
methods.description: Updates an existing cluster.

methods.name: updateClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a cluster.
